title: Chapter 465: Happy Birthday
content:
Chapter 465: Happy Birthday

Time flies, and in the blink of an eye, a long period of time has passed.

At this time, at the border of the universe, countless ancient houses that were once stationed here have been completely destroyed as the world collapses.

Alas.

Heavy sighs and a helpless atmosphere spread from the entire border of the universe.

It has finally come to this.

The several ancient monsters in the lead slowly closed their eyes, as if they were desperate.

The surrounding creatures also lowered their heads, and the atmosphere was extremely depressed.

The world collapse is already imminent, and no one or thing can survive.

And at this moment, a human race strongman suddenly raised his head and shouted loudly: "That Lord Lu has not come back yet!"

Lu Daosheng.

One sentence instantly ignited the hope in the hearts of everyone present.

Yes, Senior Lu said at the beginning that he would find a way.

They still have the last hope.

"Everyone, I've been waiting for a long time."

At this time, a gentle voice appeared in everyone's ears, causing everyone present to tremble all over.

All turned around and looked.

Seeing that a familiar figure was walking slowly towards here.

Lu Daosheng!

"Senior Lu is here!"

"Lord Lord of Huangcheng will definitely find a way!"

"I believe in this Lord!"

The living beings stared at Lu Daosheng's figure closely, their eyes full of expectation.

If Lu Daosheng couldn't do anything, then they were completely finished.

Looking at the living beings who had tried so hard, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly and stretched out his arms.

The next moment, a gentle but irresistible force swept out.

Buzz——

Everyone only felt a breeze blowing past, and when they opened their eyes again, the boundary of the universe behind them suddenly changed.

"Look, the ancient house is recovering!"

"Hahaha, I knew this lord could do it!"

"Uh,"

Everyone looked at the seemingly recovering boundary of the universe, but they were not happy for too long before they found that the boundary of the universe was not really recovering, but evolving in another form.

"This,"

Several creatures with strong auras looked at Lu Daosheng in confusion, not understanding what he meant.

But Lu Daosheng just smiled and said nothing more.

The next moment, a shocking scene appeared in front of everyone.

Everyone's expressions gradually became dull, and some even almost popped their eyes out, with unbelievable faces.

I saw familiar figures walking out of the broken boundary of the universe and coming to everyone.

Those were the ancestors who had given their lives to maintain the boundary of the universe.

They were all the former comrades of this creature.

Among them, the self-sacrificing Human Emperor!

All of them were resurrected without a single one missing.

"Teacher, I knew you could do it."

The Human Emperor looked at Lu Daosheng and chuckled.

Lu Daosheng has surpassed his previous limits. Nothing is impossible in his hands!

"Everyone, everything is over."

"The world will not forget your efforts over the years, including the lives of the entire world."

Lu Daosheng spoke slowly, making the eyes of all the creatures present moist.

They have been here for endless years and never thought that there would be such a day.

Lu Daosheng is undoubtedly their god.

"Thank you, sir!"

Everyone thanked him in unison.

Looking at everyone, Lu Daosheng nodded, then waved his hand, and everyone disappeared from the spot.

In an instant, only Lu Daosheng was left at the border of the entire universe.

This world has completely collapsed.

Although Lu Daosheng can reverse it, it is only a temporary solution.

The space fluctuated slowly.

Lu Daosheng spread his palm, and the Eternal Continent suddenly appeared in his palm and floated quietly.

But looking closely, he found that although the laws in this Eternal Continent are complete and the space is stable, there are almost no living creatures in it.

This is not the Eternal Continent that Lu Daosheng once built by gathering all the worlds, but the Eternal Continent that was recreated by relying on the true source of the world.

With the blessing of Lu Daosheng, this Eternal Continent will truly be eternal.

"It's time."

Lu Daosheng murmured, and the next moment, Lu Daosheng disappeared on the spot.

..........

At this time, after the baptism of the great era, the Eternal Continent has restored stability. Under the almost abnormal and terrifying power of the Deserted City, the entire Eternal Continent has achieved unification.

The strongest force is the Deserted City of the Heavenly Domain.

And the Heavenly Domain, under the influence of the Deserted City, deservedly became the center of the Eternal Continent, the place of yearning for countless creatures.

The Human Emperor Palace of the former Chaos Realm has also become the strongest force of the human race, commanding the human race of the entire Eternal Continent.

At this time, a figure suddenly appeared above the center of the Eternal Continent.

It was Lu Daosheng.

Looking at the Eternal Continent under his feet, Lu Daosheng waved his hand.

Suddenly, a giant hand that was big enough to hold the entire Eternal Continent grasped the Eternal Continent with one hand.

All this happened in an instant.

So fast that the creatures of the Eternal Continent did not react at all.

Hualalalalal.

In the turbulent river of time, a figure walked slowly downstream with firm steps.

Soon, a broken river appeared in front.

The road seemed to end.

There is no future in this world.

In response, Lu Daosheng's face did not fluctuate at all, and the Eternal Continent suddenly appeared in his hand.

This is the true eternal continent, the true eternity.

All creatures have moved to it under his arrangement.

"go."

Lu Daosheng chuckled lightly.

The Eternal Continent in his hand shot away immediately.

Rumble!

A loud roar came.

The Eternal Continent suddenly broke through the limitations of the long river of time and suppressed it in the lower reaches of the long river.

If there is no future, then create the future.

In this way, the world ushered in eternity.

And Lu Daosheng is the master of this world, controlling life and death and controlling reincarnation!

.........

"If it weren't for those ancestors, our world would probably have been done."

On the rough big tree stump, an old man sighed and sighed at the children sitting in a circle.

At this time, a little girl with two ponytails raised her hand and said, "Grandpa, have those ancestors not completely solved it? Then why are we still alive?"

"Yeah yeah!"

The children around him nodded one after another, with the same doubts.

Obviously, this group of children is very smart.

Hearing this question, a smile suddenly appeared on the old man's wrinkled old face.

"This is of course because of that great man."

As he said that, the old man signaled the children to look up, and suddenly, a giant city emitting sacred yellow light appeared in the children's vision.

"We can have a happy and stable life today thanks to that great man."

"Do you want to meet him?"

The old man lowered his head again and chuckled at the children.

"Think of it!!"

The children's eyes are innocent, but they are bright and thorough, with a hint of tenacity.

"Haha, then work hard."

"Maybe one day, some of you will really be able to enter the deserted city and see the glory of that great man."

.........

The deserted city, in the city lord's mansion.

"Dad, Dad!"

In the elegant courtyard, Lu Daosheng lay on the chair and napped. When he heard the familiar shouts, he immediately opened his eyes in a daze.

As soon as he saw the eyes, a delicate and flawless white face appeared in Lu Daosheng's eyes.

It is his own baby daughter Lu Xue.

At this time, Lu Xue put her hands on her back and looked at Lu Daosheng with a smile on her face.

"Dad, I've prepared a surprise for you."

"Oh? Surprise?"

Lu Daosheng raised his eyebrows and looked behind Lu Xue. In just a moment, Lu Daosheng knew what it was.

Without waiting for Lu Daosheng to continue, Lu Xue handed a cream cake to Lu Daosheng the next moment.

Bang bang bang!

Several fireworks suddenly sounded one after another from the courtyard.

Several familiar figures appeared around, with their own wife, Yan Lingyun.

There are also Ao Qing, Awei, Gu Chen, Anxing, Huangshou, Yunqi, Ouyang Yanqing, Wanfeng, Qin Yi, Mu Chen, Xu Qingzhi, Jiangbei, Yu Qingfeng, and the former gods Chao and others, including Yueming, Jing, etc., in an instant, the entire courtyard was filled with people.

Everyone looked at Lu Daosheng together, with a bright smile on his face.

"Happy birthday, dad!"

"Happy birthday, Daosheng."

"Happy birthday, Lord, Lord!"

Over the years, Lu Daosheng has long closed his strength and let himself recall the happiness of his mortals.

Even though I still saved some, I was still very surprised by this sudden moment.

He subconsciously looked at the cream cake in Lu Xue's hand.

He knew that Lu Xue had already been to Blue Star.

This birthday cake is exactly their Blue Star’s habit. There are three villains on the cake, which is the three of them.

"Birthday,,"

Lu Daosheng raised his slightly slow hands, took the cake, with a strange smile on his face.

It’s been a long time since my last birthday.

"Dad, make a wish!"

Lu Xue stood in front of Lu Daosheng and couldn't wait to say.

At this time, Yan Lingyun, who was standing beside her, reminded: "If you make a wish, you must blow the candle."

Lu Xue quickly took out a candle and inserted it into the cake.

Ao Qing opened his mouth slightly, and a tiny dragon flame immediately lit the candle.

"By the way, I have to turn off the lights!"

I don't know who shouted.

Yan Lingyun waved her sleeves quickly, and the entire courtyard suddenly fell into darkness, only the birthday cake in Lu Daosheng's hand emitted a faint light.

Seeing everyone's big scenes, Lu Daosheng smiled a little helplessly, but he was very moved.

"Make a wish quickly, make a wish!"

"Okay, okay."

Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled, then folded his hands and closed his eyes.

After three breaths, Lu Daosheng suddenly opened his eyes.

Huh ~

He blew out all the candles in one breath.

The next moment, the light returned to the courtyard.

"Dad, what wish did you make?"

At this time, Lu Xue secretly came over and asked curiously.

Yan Lingyun touched Lu Xue's hair and chuckled, "If you say your wishes, you won't work."

Lu Daosheng laughed, "But it's okay."

"Of course I wish everyone happiness every day."

Everyone here is happy every day!

(The book is over)

Author's message: Time flies so fast. This book has gone through many ups and downs, and finally finished after being written intermittently. I also thought about giving up halfway, because I wrote this book just on a whim, and I didn't expect so many people to read it. Of course, it's impossible for everyone to like what I wrote, and there are many bad comments (it's okay, I never read bad comments), but it's finally finished. I basically don't take the initiative to send messages because I always stop updating and I don't have the face to talk, because sometimes I really don't have time, and I'm not a full-time author. In short, thank you for your support. Although there are very few people who can see this, I also insisted on writing it because of you. Maybe the ending is not very perfect, but the author has really tried his best.

If there is a chance, maybe we can see each other in the next work.

I wish you all a happy day!
